title: Definition-owned motion
intent: Exercise inherited chart motion with mark, datum, axis, tick, and label overrides authored beside their definitions.

ai.create: Create a composed bar and line chart whose motion defaults live on the chart definition and whose marks, data, axes, ticks, and labels override those defaults locally.
ai.maintain: Keep motion configuration renderer-neutral, preserve spring momentum on interrupted mark updates, and keep guide transitions as local definition overrides.
